top_blockers: Admin scopes and object model complexity
Marketplace OAuth review for public distribution
OAuth app review and per-account permissions
Legacy OAuth patterns and app-specific permissions
API access depends on paid plan/admin

method: Fetch each official evidence URL from data/apps.tsv.
Strip scripts/styles and extract visible page text.
Detect auth, API-surface, access-gate, and MCP signals with deterministic keyword groups.
Compare detected signals with the curated row and mark unsupported rows for human review.
Assign every app a confidence label: Agent-supported, Human-reviewed, Curated-docs reviewed, or Needs follow-up.
Keep ambiguous/gated/no-public-docs cases as findings rather than forcing a buildable answer.
evidence_report.human_review_policy: Rows with low signals, blocked docs, or product/API ambiguity are routed to manual verification.

Salesforce.check: Docs expose multiple APIs and OAuth patterns; dev org path is self-serve.

HubSpot.check: Auth docs state OAuth for public apps and private app access tokens for single-account use.

Google Ads.check: Developer token is required; test access is self-serve while production levels are reviewed.

Amazon Selling Partner.check: Sandbox path exists, but production public apps require developer registration, roles, and review.

Pumble.check: First pass treated webhooks as an API. Verification downgraded it to not-yet buildable.

fanbasis.check: No stable public developer docs were found; kept as outreach/not-yet instead of guessing.

GitHub.check: REST and GraphQL APIs plus GitHub App/PAT/OAuth auth are well documented.

Snowflake.check: Added SQL API auth nuance: key-pair JWT, OAuth, username/password, and PAT patterns.

Notion.check: Internal tokens and OAuth are documented; page sharing remains the main agent blocker.

Stripe.check: API keys and Connect OAuth are documented; live activation/compliance is the limiter.

NotebookLM.check: First pass overfit Gemini docs. Verification changed verdict to no standalone public API.

Devin.check: Docs expose API/MCP integration path, with account/action-safety as the limiter.

known_limits: Official docs were preferred; gated products are marked as partial or not-yet.
MCP presence is a discovery signal, not a guarantee of production readiness.
